messages.content: Decompose and delegate as a parallel fanout, then synthesize: produce a combined briefing for our Director model decision that compares Claude Haiku vs Sonnet on (1) COST and (2) LATENCY. Fan out the two analyses to researchers, then have a synthesis subtask combine them into one recommendation file. Each piece writes its own file under team/drafts/. Do not do the work yourself; delegate it.
